# Test Report TR-0398

Sample: knitted T-shirt, style 107-208, colour navy.

Fibre content claimed: 60% cotton / 40% polyester.

## Summary

The sample meets the dimensional stability requirement. It does not meet the colour fastness to laundering requirement (grade 3 vs. required 4). Bursting strength was 412 kPa, i.e. above the 350 kPa minimum.

## Results

| Test | Method | Result | Requirement | Pass/Fail |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dimensional stability | AATCC 135 | -3.1% length | max. -5% | Pass |
| Colour fastness to laundering | ISO 105-C06:2010 | Grade 3 | Grade 4 | Fail |
| Bursting strength | ASTM D3786 | 412 kPa | 350 kPa min. | Pass |

## Recommendations

- Re-dye with a reactive dye recipe and re-test to ISO 105-C06.
- Keep the current knitting parameters.

Tested by: Lab No. 2, approved 2026-04-02.
